leagueGuideTitle: How to play your {{venue}} League rounds
leagueGuideStep1: Open the My Account section of the {{venue}} app.
leagueGuideStep2: In GSPRO, go to Players and click Guest 1. Change the information to your User and UID — make sure the upper and lower case of your username matches exactly.
leagueGuideStep4: Click Tournaments. Your league rounds will show up.
leagueGuideStep5: Next time you book a session at {{venue}}, you'll be automatically logged in with your SGT details.
leagueGuideTip: If you don't complete a full round, quit while you're on the tee box of any hole. Quitting midway through a hole can cause bugs.
